messages:
jamal_sales: FYI - Stellaris Health wants to move forward with a POC but tossed a big list of identity/infosec asks. TL;DR: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (delta sync), RBAC groups, domain lock, EU data residency, and details on pricing for hosted vs dedicated.

alex_k: thanks Jamal. Can you paste the customer's exact SCIM and SSO requirements? any expected user scale? also do they require delegated admin roles?

jamal_sales: They said ~1k users initially, 10k over 12 months. Need group-based RBAC (sync groups from IdP), delegated tenant admins, domain ownership verification (prevent tenant takeover), and SCIM rate limit tolerance (they use Okta with delta windows). They also flagged requirement for KMS-backed encryption and EU data residency for PHI.

maria_product: notes: our hosted plan supports SAML + SCIM basic and group membership mapping; dedicated/private can give EU-only residency and customer-managed KMS. For RBAC/group sync we currently support group membership mapping via SCIM v2. We don't have delegated admin UI in hosted today (that's a Private feature).

olivia_sec: security checklist: they asked for answers to the standard security questionnaire (SOC2 + encryption at rest in transit). We need to confirm certs, KMS options, PCI/PHI handling, and whether we can provide ATO artifacts. I'll take the questionnaire but need 48h to collate.

ben_eng: technical notes on SCIM: our SCIM endpoint supports bulk delta (startIndex/changes) and typical Okta delta token patterns. Rate limit is 200 reqs/min by default for hosted; Dedicated can increase. We map groups to role attributes using the SCIM 'groups' array. Example mapping snippet:

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
{
  "schemas": [...],
  "groups": [{"value":"engineering","display":"Engineering"}]
}
```

jamal_sales: customer wants to know upfront the incremental cost for SCIM provisioning and for adding domain lock + delegated admin. Also what's the SLA expectation for Dedicated?

maria_product: pricing: hosted - SCIM included up to 5k active identities; above that we add a provisioning surcharge (per 1k). Dedicated - reserved capacity + platform fee; domain-lock and delegated admin tooling are part of Private tier (one-time onboarding + monthly). I can pull exact numbers but need to know expected throughput (provisioning spikes) and whether they need realtime provisioning (<30s).

olivia_sec: for their security questionnaire: we can provide SOC2 Type II report, TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 rest. For KMS we support customer-managed keys (KMS) in Dedicated/Private. We cannot provide on-host HSM attestation for hosted customers. Also need to confirm data location for EU residency (we have regions eu-west-1 and eu-central-1).

jamal_sales: they're asking for a sample SAML metadata we expect from IdP and the attribute mapping for SCIM (email, givenName, familyName, groups). Can someone paste a template I can forward?

alex_k: paste for SAML metadata & attrs:
```
<saml2:EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com">
  <md:SPSSODescriptor>
    <md:AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://app.redwood.example.com/sso/callback"/>
  </md:SPSSODescriptor>
</saml2:EntityDescriptor>
```
Attributes: `email`, `name`, `givenName`, `familyName`, `groups` (groups claim must be a list).

ben_eng: also tell them to send the Okta SCIM adapter config we can support both bulk and delta sync. If they want <30s provisioning we'll need to enable webhook-driven provisioning on their side or use Dedicated with higher rate limits.

jamal_sales: perfect. I'll share the sample and ask for their SCIM adapter logs and expected peaks. Also asking for their security questionnaire deadline — they want answers in 3 business days. Olivia, you said 48h to collate?

olivia_sec: I can get the core security answers + SOC2 artifacts in 48h. For KMS legal docs and EU residency confirmation might take product + legal 72h.

maria_product: action items: (1) Jamal to request their SCIM delta example + Okta config and estimated provisioning spike (2) Olivia to compile sec questionnaire partial answers in 48h and list items needing legal (3) Ben to draft a short doc on provisioning latency options and rate limits for POC (4) I'll draft a pricing ballpark for hosted vs dedicated including onboarding fees.

jamal_sales: sounds good. Stellaris wants a 2-week POC window starting next Mon. Can we commit on a POC scope that excludes delegated admin UI but includes SSO, SCIM group sync, and domain lock?

maria_product: yes we can do SSO + SCIM + domain verification in Hosted POC. Delegated admin and KMS customer-managed keys require Dedicated/Private onboarding. We'll note that in the Statement of Work for the POC and provide migration path.

jamal_sales: thanks. I'll confirm scope and push timeline. tagging @olivia_sec and @ben_eng for follow-ups. :thumbsup:

sec_bot: Reminder: attach redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf when responding to security questionnaires — link: https://internal.redwood.com/sec/redwood-sec-package-v2.pdf

jamal_sales: attached the doc link in the reply to the customer. I'll update this thread once they send SCIM config.
